instruction: Please help me change the cursor style in VS Code to line.

parameters.command: SETTINGS_PATH="$HOME/.config/Code/User/settings.json"; [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_PATH" ] && echo '{"editor.cursorStyle": "block"}' > "$SETTINGS_PATH" || (grep -q "editor.cursorStyle" "$SETTINGS_PATH" && sed -i 's/"editor.cursorStyle": "[^"]*"/"editor.cursorStyle": "block"/' "$SETTINGS_PATH" || jq '. + {"editor.cursorStyle": "block"}' "$SETTINGS_PATH" > temp.json && mv temp.json "$SETTINGS_PATH")

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VS Code cursor style from 'block' to 'line'. Evaluator uses existing check_json_settings function to verify the editor.cursorStyle setting in settings.json.
